items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: I remember him saying there one day, and we'd like to die, he said, "God-dam it, girls, grind, grind."

ctx.x: And while he's in the front of them doing all these steps, the girls are doing their drill behind him. Well this was a great thing, so. And then also we had a -- that was the first real production, because Clarence Robinson was another one in that show. He was a great guy in that show. he played the parts. He was the (unintelligible) We had an Oriental number. And it was done by a man, I guess he's dead now, too. Bunny Barney Weldon. Bunny Barney Weldon was one of the white producers on Broadway, and he -- these…
